name: Santa Fe Relocation
summary: Global relocation firm on many corporate vendor lists — door-to-door household goods inbound and outbound, plus destination orientation.
body: Santa Fe and peers often appear on corporate approved-vendor lists for both inbound and outbound moves. Self-movers should still compare Singapore destination-agent quality, storage fees, and Customs GST-relief handling as carefully as origin pack pricing. On exit, get like-for-like quotes against shared-crate services and SingPost for tiny volumes — furniture rarely pays to ship when the destination has IKEA. Confirm who owns inventory accuracy, insurance valuation, condo lift bookings, and packing-waste disposal in writing before the container sails. Pair with the shipping-household and shipping-out guides.
whenToEngage: On corporate approved-vendor list for door-to-door
Comparing outbound crate vs SingPost for small volume
Need destination-agent quality check in writing
